import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/t')
from run import run
def mk(data):
    c=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],
        "expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h.example"}}]
    return {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":c,"events":[],
            "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":data}]}]}
def probe(label, data):
    out = run(mk(data))
    if 'error' in out: print('%-40s -> INPUT ERROR'%label); return
    ch=out['channels'][0]
    print('%-40s -> err=%s reqs=%d'%(label, ch['error'], len(ch['requests'])))
# exactly 8192 content bytes in a header line: "X:" + 8190 a's = 8192

probe('remaining 8194 no LF', "GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\n" + "a"*8194)
# block size limit: request line + headers + empty line == 65536
head = "GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\n"
tail = "\r\n"
pad = 65536 - len(head) - len(tail) - len("X: \r\n")
